title: Export Windows Autopilot devices with group tag and enrollment state
summary: Check that imported hardware hashes carry the right group tag and see which devices never enrolled, before a rollout wave.
code:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'DeviceManagementServiceConfig.Read.All'

Get-MgDeviceManagementWindowsAutopilotDeviceIdentity -All |
  Select-Object SerialNumber, Manufacturer, Model, GroupTag, EnrollmentState, LastContactedDateTime |
  Sort-Object GroupTag, SerialNumber |
  Export-Csv .\autopilot-devices.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8
notes: Empty GroupTag on devices that should get a tag-based dynamic group means the profile won't apply.
EnrollmentState values: unknown, enrolled, pendingReset, failed, notContacted.

source.label: Pre-stage Windows devices for Autopilot: hardware hash import vs corporate identifiers
